title: Retry an assertion
summary: Cypress retries many queries and assertions until they pass or time out. Check a real condition instead of guessing a delay.
introduction: Cypress retries many queries and assertions until they pass or time out. Check a real condition instead of guessing a delay. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Cypress retries many queries and assertions until they pass or time out. Check a real condition instead of guessing a delay.

blocks.title: Retry an assertion

blocks.text: The assertion waits for the visible Ready paragraph within its configured time limit.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Ask for missing text and read the timeout message.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Arbitrary cy.wait delays can make tests both slow and unreliable.
For more detail later, use this [Cypress further reading](https://docs.cypress.io/app/get-started/why-cypress).
